scheme_name: Coaching Assistance Scheme For Scheduled Caste Students For Pre-Exam Preparation Like NEET, JEE, GUJCET
other_conditions: Must have scored 70% or more marks in Std. 10
Must be studying in Std. 12 Science stream
Must be preparing for exams such as NEET, JEE, or GUJCET
benefits_summary: Up to ₹20,000 or the actual fee, whichever is less, is transferred directly to the student's bank account via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
